2025/0348(CNS) | EU Anti-Fraud Tax Access
Rapporteur: Michalis Hadjipantela (EPP) | Lead committee: ECON

📅 27 July 2026 | 📜 Published in the Official Journal
What's next: It's law. It enters into force on the date it specifies or, if none, the 20th day after publication in the Official Journal.

Summary: This law allows two European agencies that fight fraud and financial crime to access value added tax records across the EU so they can investigate cases more effectively.
